tagline: Page changes, without the false alarms

slides.title: Know when a page changes
slides.text: A whole page, or just the price or stock label. A notification, a count on the icon, and what changed.

slides.title: No false alarms from timestamps
slides.text: A second look right after you add a page learns what changes on every visit (counters, ids, recommendations) and ignores it. Real changes still get through.

slides.title: Pick the part you care about
slides.text: Click a price, a stock label or a list on the page. Page Watch tells you what it will watch, in plain words.

slides.title: Price history and 30-day lows
slides.text: Every checked value in a chart. Get told when it drops below your target or hits its lowest in 30 days.

slides.title: Private by design
slides.text: Checks run in your browser, only while Chrome is open. No account, no server, no analytics. Light and dark.
